title: Build and defend a colour palette
description: Construct a five-colour palette for each of three fictitious clients, and justify each palette against the client's stated audience and mood. [Bloom: Create, Evaluate] [Also rolls up to Competency 3]
display_name: Build and defend a colour palette

title: Draw with the Pen tool
description: Define the core Illustrator terms (artboard, path, anchor point, stroke, fill). Trace a reference shape with the Pen tool, producing closed paths with clean anchor points. Identify contrast, hierarchy, and alignment in a finished design. [Bloom: Remember, Apply, Analyze] [Also rolls up to Competency 2]

title: Sketch and select a poster composition
description: Sketch four thumbnail compositions for a vector travel poster. Select one and justify the choice by naming the hierarchy and contrast decisions that drove it. [Bloom: Create, Evaluate] [Also rolls up to Competency 4, capture]
display_name: Sketch and select a poster composition

title: Build a vector travel poster
description: Construct an 18x24 vector travel poster in Illustrator, applying a defined palette, limited typography, and a clear focal hierarchy. Simplify source imagery into clean vector shapes using the Pen tool. [Bloom: Create, Apply] [Also rolls up to Competency 3]

title: Revise from critique and export for print
description: Revise the poster in response to at least two specific peer critiques. Articulate what changed and why, naming the design principle involved. Export a print-ready PDF and a web JPG. [Bloom: Evaluate, Apply] [Also rolls up to Competency 4, output]
display_name: Revise from critique and export for print

title: Isolate a subject in Photoshop
description: Isolate three subjects from their backgrounds using Select Subject and the Object Selection tool, and refine the edges. Locate proximity, repetition, and white space in a finished composition. [Bloom: Apply, Analyze] [Also rolls up to Competency 2]

title: Plan a postcard that extends the poster
description: Sketch a 1200x1800 travel postcard that extends the poster's typeface and palette to a new format. Explain which selection technique each element will require. [Bloom: Create, Understand] [Also rolls up to Competency 4, capture]
display_name: Plan a postcard that extends the poster

title: Composite a layered postcard
description: Composite a destination photograph, an isolated subject, and typography into a layered 1200x1800 PSD, maintaining each element on its own editable layer. [Bloom: Apply, Create] [Also rolls up to Competencies 3 and 5] [LOAD-BEARING: the After Effects project imports this PSD as a Composition. A flattened file breaks the next project.]

title: Animate with keyframes
description: Animate a single layer into frame using two Position keyframes. Explain in your own words what a keyframe does. Analyze how balance and emphasis change over time in a moving composition. [Bloom: Apply, Understand, Analyze] [Also rolls up to Competency 2]

title: Storyboard a motion sequence
description: Sketch four to six storyboard frames with direction arrows, sequencing the order and timing of each element's entrance. [Bloom: Create] [Also rolls up to Competency 4, capture]

title: Build and export an animation
description: Import a layered PSD into After Effects as a Composition. Animate two layers into frame using paired Position keyframes, matching the storyboard's timing. Export an H.264 MP4. [Bloom: Apply] [Also rolls up to Competencies 3 and 5]

title: Curate and publish a portfolio
description: Curate three finished projects into a single published Behance project, sequencing them strongest work first. Compose a project description naming the tools used and one design decision you would defend. [Bloom: Create, Evaluate]

title: Operate the course toolchain
description: Set up and operate the hardware, software, and accounts the course depends on: Adobe Creative Cloud, Canvas, Discord, and Miro. Locate and use campus technical support. [Bloom: Apply]

title: Capture physical work for critique
description: Photograph or scan physical thumbnail sketches square to the page, evenly lit, in focus, and at a resolution where the linework reads at full size in Miro. If a classmate cannot see it, they cannot critique it. [Bloom: Apply] [Assessed in the critique, across all three projects]
